point.carrier: 31 MHz, 2 Vpp equivalent at TP2 interface

definitions.carrier_vpp_high: median carrier Vpp on the central 60% of the high envelope plateau
definitions.carrier_vpp_low: median carrier Vpp on the central 60% of the low envelope plateau
definitions.mean_carrier_vpp: 2 * time average of the demodulated carrier peak envelope over one complete 20 kHz period
definitions.at_50pct_duty: mean_carrier_vpp equals the arithmetic mean of high and low plateau Vpp
